collection.title: SEAT Arona 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a SEAT Arona 2017 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Passat Estate which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.

image.alt: SEAT Arona 2017 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
